svg.aria-label: 8-Question Adaptive Assessment Generation and Context Flow Architecture

g.text: Architecture Specification / Low-Level Pipeline & Context Propagation
2 Technical Skills • 2 Behavioral Judgments • 2 Team Collaborations • 2 Coding MCQs (100% Respected-Topic Context Isolation)
Tests baseline mastery in declared tech stack.
Challenges edge cases & decisions in Answer 1.
Probes individual role in conflict resolution.
PARALLEL BACKGROUND GENERATION TRACK • RUNS SIMULTANEOUSLY DURING CANDIDATE DWELL TIME
1. • Every seed question uses strictly profile/skills with zero answer context.
2. • Every follow-up question pressure-tests ONLY the answer from that respected topic.
3. • Dwell time parallelization delivers 100% of questions in <10ms.
